title: Galfar Webapp
description: Independently led the end-to-end development of a configurable enterprise workflow and approval platform, owning the solution from requirements gathering and system architecture through development, deployment, and documentation. Architected and delivered scalable React.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL solutions supporting multi-level approvals, rule-based workflow routing, SLA monitoring, automated escalations, audit trails, document management, email notifications, and real-time process tracking across multiple business departments. Streamlined complex business processes by digitizing and automating approvals, improving operational visibility, reducing manual intervention, and enabling scalable workflow management.
